uncited: **Compute Update Gate:** Concatenate the previous global volume and the local volume along the feature dimension: $[\mathcal{V}_{t-1}^g, \mathcal{V}_t]$.
**Compute Candidate Volume:** Element-wise multiply the previous global volume by the reset gate: $r_t * \mathcal{V}_{t-1}^g$.
Concatenate this result with the local volume: $[r_t * \mathcal{V}_{t-1}^g, \mathcal{V}_t]$.
**Sparse Application:** Steps 2–5 are applied only to voxels covered by the local volume $\mathcal{V}_t$.
*   **Sparsity Alignment:** The concatenation and element-wise operations must correctly handle the sparse structure.
